Discover Financial Svcs (DFS) Shareholder Cumberland Partners LTD Has Raised Its Stake by $1.88 Million; New Vernon Investment Management Maintains Stake in American Finl Group Ohio (AFG)
May 6, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Andrew Wallach increased its stake in Discover Financial Svcs (DFS) by 7.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cumberland Partners Ltd bought 24,785 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.95% with the market. The hedge fund run by Andrew Wallach held 372,060 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $28.62 million, up from 347,275 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cumberland Partners Ltd who had been investing in Discover Financial Svcs for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $24.73 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.82% or $1.27 during the last trading session, reaching $70.87. About 1.85M shares traded. Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS) has risen 5.15% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.40% the S&P500.
New Vernon Investment Management Llc increased its stake in American Finl Group Inc Ohio (AFG) by 9.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. New Vernon Investment Management Llc bought 2,827 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.85% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 31,147 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.38 million, up from 28,320 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New Vernon Investment Management Llc who had been investing in American Finl Group Inc Ohio for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.77B market cap company. The stock increased 1.06% or $1.15 during the last trading session, reaching $109.97. About 278,206 shares traded. American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE:AFG) has risen 22.13% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.58% the S&P500.
Among 33 analysts covering Discover Financial Services ( NYSE:DFS ), 21 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Discover Financial Services had 101 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Wednesday, January 24, the company rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, October 10 by Wells Fargo. The rating was maintained by JP Morgan on Wednesday, April 20 with “Neutral”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank given on Thursday, January 7. The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets on Wednesday, April 12 with “Hold”. The company was maintained on Wednesday, October 21 by Oppenheimer. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Bank of America given on Thursday, February 11. Evercore downgraded the stock to “In-Line” rating in Thursday, January 25 report. Macquarie Research downgraded the shares of DFS in report on Wednesday, May 11 to “Neutral” rating. The stock of Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS) earned “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Monday, December 18.

Cumberland Partners Ltd, which manages about $759.83M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 36,262 shares to 50,557 shares, valued at $8.56M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Capital One Fincl Corp (NYSE:COF) by 8,480 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 85,975 shares, and cut its stake in General Motors Company (NYSE:GM).
